drills.title: Work the Plunge Ladder
drills.text: There is no lockdown button here — the plunger is the extra control, and seven distinct strengths send the ball to seven different first shots. Climb the ladder deliberately: shortest into the Ello Worm staging area, medium up the right orbit onto the upper flipper for the Change Mode target, medium-strong into the Wiseman scoop, strong-but-not-full into the Village. Learn where each pull dies rather than pulling the same one every ball.

drills.title: Upper Flipper Menu
drills.text: From a settled ball on the upper right flipper you own four shots: the Change Mode target, the center ramp, the bridge loop, and the Orb collect that drops right off the tip. Cycle them in order from up there. The bridge loop only registers as itself once the right orbit switches have been tripped, so watch what the game calls your shot rather than assuming.

drills.title: Cleaners Build and Cash
drills.text: Rip the left-orbit spinner to inflate the hurry-up, then swing over and cash it at the right orbit, three times per attempt. The drill is knowing when to stop building — letting the clock reach thirteen pays nothing, so practice cashing a shade earlier than feels right.

drills.title: Bog Discrimination
drills.text: The sequence runs across the left ramp, the right ramp, the left orbit, the right side of the Horseshoe and the right orbit, and at each step only the orange shot is safe — the two green ones flanking it carry a penalty for the rest of the game. This is a drill in not shooting: cradle, read the colors, then commit.

drills.title: Drop-and-Scoop Pair
drills.text: Knock down the Wiseman drop target and put the ball in the scoop behind it before the target pops back up. That pair is the whole Quest engine and it repeats all game, so drill it as one motion; when you miss the window, knock again and retake it instead of wandering off to another shot.

drills.title: Build HELP Before You Need It
drills.text: Spelling HELP through the in and outlanes arms the Sir Didymus staff post above the left outlane, so treat those lanes as a save you build rather than letters you happen to collect. Play a full ball where routing returns through unlit lanes comes before any mode shot, and note the moment the post is armed — that is when the left side is safe to play loose.

actionButton.how: Despite being a brand-new machine, Labyrinth skips the lockdown-bar button entirely. The cabinet carries two flipper buttons, a green start button, and a genuine spring plunger — nothing else to press. Your extra layer of control is the plunger itself: seven distinct plunge strengths send the ball to seven different first shots, and everything after that is flippers.

howItPlays.objective: Labyrinth sends you through Jareth's maze to befriend Hoggle, Ludo and Sir Didymus and clear the story modes hidden inside it. Almost everything you finish -- modes, quests, multiballs, friendships -- pays out an Orb, and thirteen Orbs open Battle Jareth.
loop: Use the plunger's seven strengths to pick your first shot, since there is no lockbar button and everything after the plunge is flippers.
Advance and collect each Friend to climb their levels, and open Wiseman Quests early so the bonus multiplier compounds all ball.
Start a story mode at the Horseshoe -- cycling which one is lit with the Change Mode target -- and clear it for an Orb.
Build the four multiballs, each of which banks an Orb of its own, and grind the Cleaners hurry-up for another.
Collect all thirteen Orbs to light the back-left castle for Battle Jareth.

lights.name: Friend Circles
lights.lit: Each Friend has a color -- Hoggle yellow, Ludo orange, Sir Didymus blue -- and hitting the lit circle then its relocating collect shot is one level; levels are tracked per Friend and carry from ball to ball.
lights.flashing: Helping Hands flashes green once all three Friends hold a jackpot, meaning Friend Multiball is ready to start.

control.effect: holding either flipper button as Helping Hands flashes declines the Friend Multiball start, so you can keep leveling the Friends for bigger jackpots instead of cashing in early
control.when: when Helping Hands flashes green to start Friend Multiball

lights.then: Cash Friend Multiball for a quick Orb, or hold off and take each Friend all the way to Level 4 -- every Friend that reaches it lights an Orb of its own.

lights.name: Wiseman Quests
lights.lit: Knocking down the drop target guarding the scoop opens it for a random Quest -- five ramps, five orbits, ten targets -- and the drop resets itself within a few seconds, so treat the knock-then-scoop as a single motion.
lights.then: Every finished Quest adds a step to your end-of-ball bonus multiplier, so start them early to compound; the sixth completion lights an Orb, and the fourth auto-starts Wiseman Multiball.

lights.name: Brick Keeper Locks
lights.lit: The wall target and the Fairy circles light the three locks, and a green standup on each orbit plus one at the center ramp holds them; shooting the last green target starts the multiball.
lights.then: In the multiball, trap a ball in the left-orbit forks and ram the captive ball repeatedly into the spinner to pump the Super Jackpot higher before you cash it -- banking five supers across the multiball lights an Orb, and every relight demands one more regular jackpot than the one before.

lights.name: The Cleaners Hurry-Up
lights.lit: Ripping the left-orbit spinner inflates a hurry-up whose value only counts once you cash it at the right orbit; the longer you spin the bigger the collect, but letting the clock strike thirteen pays nothing.
lights.then: Cash it up to three times per attempt, stopping a shade earlier than feels right, and reach five million across the collects to light an Orb.

lights.name: Story Modes
lights.lit: When no mode is running, an insert shows which story mode is queued, and a hit on the Change Mode target from the upper flipper rotates it to the one you want; the Horseshoe starts it once Mode Start flashes.
lights.then: Clear modes for the biggest Orb bucket of all -- six of the thirteen -- and playing all three modes on one level qualifies Poisoned Peach while playing all six qualifies Goblin City.

lights.name: Orb Collect & Rainbow
lights.lit: Any mode clear, multiball jackpot, Quest milestone or Friend Level 4 lights Collect Orb at the upper-flipper shot; the ten-million Orb is the currency that gates Battle Jareth, so a lit one is never left sitting.
lights.then: Cash the Orb the moment it lights, then shoot a lit rainbow arrow to stack a multiplier onto future Orb value -- but that stacked multiplier vanishes if the ball drains before it is locked in.

lights.name: Ello Mystery & Tea Time
lights.lit: Tagging either Wiseman target that flanks the scoop lights the Ello Mystery at the upper-flipper shot; collecting it while Tea Time is the lit award starts Tea Time Multiball on the spot.
lights.then: Inflate the hurry-up first with orbit and Horseshoe shots, then bank it under the left ramp, and keep running the loop to stack more jackpots until the clock runs out.

lights.name: H-E-L-P Lanes
lights.lit: A lit HELP rollover is a letter you still need as the ball rolls the in and outlanes; treat the set as a save you are building rather than letters you happen to catch.
lights.then: Spelling HELP raises the Sir Didymus staff post over the left outlane as a ball save, and can light Helping Hands at the left scoop for a mode-tier change.

lights.name: Goblin City & Battle Jareth
lights.lit: Playing all six story modes qualifies Goblin City Multiball, whose Counterattack phase lights every shot at once for the thirteenth Orb; that final Orb and its rainbow shot are what light both orbits into the back-left castle.
lights.then: Battle Jareth is the game-ending fight fed from either orbit into the castle corner -- but a drain or a clock strike of thirteen there costs you an Orb, so keep working both orbits rather than risking the flipper-to-corner shot.

scoring.text: Medium-plunge the Target Skillshot off the upper flipper -- the highest flat skill value, and it hits Change Mode for free mode progress. Take whichever Friend circle is lit, then knock the Wiseman drop target and shoot the scoop behind it to open a Quest, starting the bonus-multiplier engine early. Spell HELP through the lanes to raise the Sir Didymus save post.

Grind Wiseman Quests for stacking bonus multiplier and build the Friends toward Level 4 -- hold a flipper to decline Friend Multiball so you keep leveling for bigger jackpots and three separate Orbs. Farm the Cleaners hurry-up off the spinner and the right orbit, and light Brick Keeper Multiball to bash the captive-ball Super Jackpot.

Orbs are the real currency: six come from clearing the story modes, more from Quests, Friend Level 4s and each multiball, and the thirteenth from a Goblin City Counterattack Super Jackpot. Collect all thirteen to light both orbits into the back-left castle for Battle Jareth, the game-ending fight, and cash every Orb the moment it lights so a drain never robs you of one.
